assumptions.choice: Treated shorting as available (backtrader's default broker permits negative positions on this single-asset feed), so used wmin=-1.0, wmax=1.0 per the spec's 'otherwise' branch.
assumptions.reason: Spec makes wmin/wmax conditional on shorting availability; the harness's default broker does not restrict short positions.

assumptions.choice: Rebalance fires on the first daily bar whose (year, month) differs from the last rebalanced (year, month) — i.e., the first trading day of each new calendar month.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'once a month' without specifying the exact trigger day; calendar-month-boundary rebalancing is the standard convention.

assumptions.choice: Used backtrader's built-in bt.indicators.ATR(period=63) with its default internal smoothing.
assumptions.reason: Spec specifies only the ATR period, not the moving-average/smoothing variant; defaulted to the indicator's built-in method since the spec is silent.

assumptions.choice: When sigma_hat < 0.005, the monthly target weight is set to 0 and applied via order_target_percent, which also closes any existing position.
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'do not enter (w=0)'; the literal reading is that the target weight for that period is 0, applied uniformly regardless of current position state.

assumptions.choice: Daily log return computed as ln(Close[t]/Close[t-1]).
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'log returns' without specifying the interval; daily log return of Close is the canonical choice on a daily bar feed.
